title: Chapter 620 - 620 Noisy; Really Noisy!
content:
Chapter 620 - 620 Noisy; Really Noisy!

Chapter 620 - 620 Noisy; Really Noisy!

620 Noisy; Really Noisy!

In fact…

It was not just the heroes on the rock island who had their mouths and eyes wide open from shock.

On Earth, almost everyone watching the live broadcast had the same expression.

Lin Fan’s sword was simply too powerful and terrifying.

It was completely beyond everyone’s imagination.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing stood rooted to the ground, her eyes unblinking.

She did not even know that the microphone in her hand had fallen to the ground.

The entire live broadcast room was very quiet for a long time.

It was as though everyone was blocked from posting comments.

After a long time…

Finally, there were some comments.

I’m Your Other Half: [Awesome!]

Zhang Wenbai: [Awesome!]

World Flame Guardian: [Awesome!]

Fish: [Awesome!]

…

After these comments appeared, a commotion was kicked up.

Countless praises filled the entire live broadcast room for a very long time!

Time and Circumstances Have Changed: [Lin Fan’s sword could break the sea and slash the sky! F*ck, this is awesome!]

Moon Bay: [Slash! Mom, he’s so handsome!]

Shura: [A god! Even among all the gods, God Lin is definitely the strongest!]

Carefree Heart: [F*ck, awesome!]

Kite: [Sword!]

People Who Like Red: [God Lin is the greatest!]

….

Many people sent comments while shouting and jumping. In an instant, the city and even the entire country… No, the entire world became noisy.

Water: [Our Hua Nation has so many resources. Moreover, our lifespan has also increased by several years! Thank you, God Lin!]

Mr. Huang: [Thank you, God Lin!]

Time Magician: [Thank you, God Lin!]

…

After a moment of excitement, the comments were filled with gratitude.

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

After slashing out with his sword, the sea finally stopped swarming with monsters.

Hence, Lin Fan waved his hand casually.

Treasure chests opened one after another.

[You’ve obtained 500 Constitution points. Do you want to use them?]

[You’ve obtained 500 points of spiritual energy. Do you want to use them?]

[You’ve obtained 500 Constitution points. Do you want to use them?]

[You’ve obtained 500 Constitution points. Do you want to use them?]

…

[You’ve obtained Beginner Illusion Technique. Do you want to use it?]

…

[You’ve obtained Beginner Curse Spell. Do you want to use it?]

…

At the same time, Lin Fan’s mind rang out with a crisp notification.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—5,000 Constitution points.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—5,000 points of spiritual energy.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—Advanced Illusion Technique.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—Advanced Curse Technique.]

…

The surging energy and refreshing spiritual energy surged wildly within Lin Fan’s body.

Instantly, the aura around Lin Fan’s body grew even more majestic and holy. It made one have the urge to kneel down and worship him.

After a while, Lin Fan retracted his aura and turned back into a normal person.

He looked at the Heavenly Hound, who was staring at the treasure chests with a burning gaze and saliva flowing out of its mouth. He smiled and said, “Go use these light orbs.”

When the Heavenly Hound heard this, its eyes instantly lit up, and its tail wagged happily.

It could not wait to go forward and swallow one ball of light after another into its stomach.

At this moment, a series of emotionless voices rang out at the scene.

[First to help level up the level-seven Heavenly Hound to level eight. You’ve obtained a level-five treasure chest.]

[First to help level up the level-seven Heavenly Hound to level eight. Hua Nation’s pollution has reduced by 10%.]

[First to help level up the level-eight Heavenly Hound to level nine. You’ve obtained a level-six treasure chest.]

[First to help level up the level-eight Heavenly Hound to level nine. Ores in Hua Nation have increased by 10%.]

[The first to establish a contract with a level-nine Heavenly Hound. You’ve obtained a level-eight treasure chest.]

[The first to establish a contract with a level-nine Heavenly Hound. The number of animal species in Hua Nation has increased by 20.]

Hence, Lin Fan, who had just opened 30 treasure chests, had three more in front of him.

At the same time, Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound had a special connection. Whatever Lin Fan thought, the Heavenly Hound could understand.

Furthermore, the Heavenly Hound could shrink and become a part of Lin Fan’s body.

As long as Lin Fan summoned it, the Heavenly Hound would be able to rush to his side from anywhere and execute all of his orders. It was extremely strange.

There were a total of 600 Constitution points and 300 points of spiritual energy in these three treasure chests.

Through the special red packets, Lin Fan gained another 6,000 Constitution points and 3,000 points of spiritual energy.

And these three light orbs, without exception, were all given to the Heavenly Hound.

After all, these three treasure chests were obtained because of the Heavenly Hound.

Furthermore, Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound had established such a special relationship.

At this moment, the heroes of the various countries on the rock island finally recovered from their shock.

Everyone looked at Lin Fan with respect.

It was as if they were looking at a god!

“As expected, he really doesn’t need those Constitution and spiritual energy points, nor techniques,” Mordmohan said softly.”

That was because the power that Lin Fan had displayed was not something that these things could do.

Abraham nodded in agreement.

At this moment, a huge sea pillar that was hundreds of meters tall suddenly rose from the sea on the left.

A ten-meter-tall man with a human face and the body of a dragon was standing on the sea pillar.

He used his pair of stern eyes to glance at everyone and said coldly, “Mere humans dare to be so impudent here. This is simply unforgivable!”

A terrifying aura crashed over like a wave.

The heroes from all over the world found it difficult to breathe, and their faces turned pale.

Of course, Lin Fan was the exception.

The man continued, “Killing my subordinates and breaking my sea is an unforgivable crime!”

His voice was like thunder, and his momentum was like a gale, causing the entire sea to boil.

Waves after waves crashed against each other and piled up!

It gradually formed a giant tsunami that was hundreds of meters tall!

It was extremely terrifying!

The heroes of the various countries and the rock island seemed to have turned into ants or small mounds in front of this tsunami.

“Die!” The man shouted loudly!

As soon as the sound fell, a tsunami that was hundreds of meters tall whistled toward everyone.

Seeing this…

Everyone’s face was pale, and cold sweat rolled down their foreheads.

This was an instinctive fear of nature.

Then, everyone seemed to have thought of something and turned their gazes to Lin Fan.

Lin Fan seemed to have sensed these gazes. Finally, he raised his head and looked at the man with an extremely calm gaze. “How noisy!”

An icy cold aura spread out.

The surface of the sea, the surging tsunami, and the man on the sea pillar were all frozen in an instant.

Instantly, the entire world became crystal clear and incomparably gorgeous.
